page.notes: The strip at the far left belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out. The passage appears to be set in italic from its first word to the last, apart from the parentheses; the italic marking was judged from the scan and may be incomplete in places. The catchword "medio" is printed at the right foot and is kept out of the text. Printed forms such as "levabuntq;", "ejus" and "Iudices" are copied as they appear.
